parameters.query:
insert into public.job_applications
  (source, external_id, title, company, url, description, score, verdict,
   top_reasons, red_flags, recommendation, salary_range, status)
values ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,$8,$9::jsonb,$10::jsonb,$11,$12,$13)
on conflict (external_id) do update set
  title = excluded.title,
  company = excluded.company,
  url = excluded.url,
  description = excluded.description,
  score = excluded.score,
  verdict = excluded.verdict,
  top_reasons = excluded.top_reasons,
  red_flags = excluded.red_flags,
  recommendation = excluded.recommendation,
  salary_range = excluded.salary_range,
  status = case when job_applications.status = 'applied' then 'applied' else excluded.status end
returning id, external_id, status;

select key, value from public.profile_facts where verified_bool = true
union all
select '_mercado', public.salary_market_prompt()
order by key;

   top_reasons, red_flags, recommendation, salary_range, status)

  salary_range = excluded.salary_range,
  status = case when job_applications.status = 'applied' then 'applied' else excluded.status end
returning id, external_id, status;

insert into public.job_applications
  (source, external_id, title, company, url, status, applied_at)
values ('extension_applied', $1, $2, $3, $4, 'applied', now())
on conflict (external_id) do update set
  status = 'applied',
  applied_at = now(),
  title = coalesce(nullif(excluded.title, ''), job_applications.title),
  company = coalesce(nullif(excluded.company, ''), job_applications.company)
returning id, external_id, title, company, status, applied_at;
